title: rarer diamonds
body:
Makes diamonds rarer and harder to find in your Minecraft world.

This plugin reduces the number of diamond ores generated in new chunks, creating a more balanced and challenging survival experience — perfect for SMPs, lifesteal servers, or hardcore worlds.

🔧 Features
💎 Reduces diamond ore generation
⛏️ Affects both stone and deepslate diamonds
🌍 Works automatically on newly generated chunks
⚙️ Simple config to adjust rarity
🚀 Lightweight and optimized for Paper servers
📊 Customization

Edit the config to control how rare diamonds are:

diamonds:
  keep-chance: 0.35
0.50 → slightly rarer
0.35 → balanced SMP feel
0.20 → very rare
0.10 → hardcore
⚠️ Important
Only affects new chunks
Existing terrain will not change
Works best when combined with anti-xray plugins
🧩 Compatibility
✅ Paper
✅ Spigot
🟢 Minecraft 1.21+
🎯 Use Cases
SMP servers
Lifesteal-style gameplay
Hardcore survival
Economy-based servers
💬 Notes

This plugin does not hide diamonds — it actually reduces how many generate, making them truly rarer.
